falsification_conditions.condition: BTC daily close finishes at least 12% above the close on the day this verdict was issued, at any point in the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The May-2022-style bottom analogue has already resolved upward. HOLD/UNKNOWN is wrong because the tape forced a directional long call.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC prints a daily close at least 10% below the lowest daily close of the prior 20 sessions within the next 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2022_may_luna pattern match failed. A hold-for-bottom stance is invalidated and the correct call is continued downside, not UNKNOWN.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 65, or VIX closes above 32 while SPX is down at least 6% from today's close, within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Either a blowoff regime or a clear risk-off phase has been identified. A blowoff score of 38 and an Unknown phase can no longer justify HOLD.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
